summary: --csv keeps the nested table when a section has an empty list, and names empty sections on stderr with their note.
reason: One empty section made righeDaOggetto give up the nested shape, so `novita --csv` and some `commissione dossier --csv` printed Go `map[...]` literals in a column instead of the rows.
validated_outcome: Live: `novita --since 7d --csv` gives 25 rows plus 9 stderr notes and no `map[`; `commissione dossier Statuto --legisl 15 --csv` gives 6 rows plus 1 note.
